title: NetSuRF controlled conditional-search measurements

final_trials.csv.unit: one natural-Bernoulli held-out fault field for one final mask

conditional_context_contributions.csv.unit: one whole-path paired contribution from one independent held-out background field

conditional_mask_comparisons.csv.unit: one final-mask comparison within a BER and replication

search_results.csv.unit: one completed named method in one BER and replication

convergence.csv.unit: one post-hoc natural held-out evaluation of an accepted search state

polar_interactions.csv.unit: one selected pair under one background context

mask_composition.csv.unit: one category count within a best mask

mask_overlap.csv.unit: one pair of best masks in one replication

null_handling: Empty CSV fields represent unavailable optional measurements; JSON uses null.
